title: Archiving of Time-of-Use Exception Responses
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
You can use the enhancement spot ISU_TOUEXCEPTRESP to define enhancements.

Archiving of Time-of-Use Exception Responses

Use

You can use archiving to store time-of-use (TOU) exception responses so that you can view and use them as required.

Prerequisites

The possible prerequisites for the different archiving steps are described below in the detailed description for the individual
process phases.

Features

The process of archiving TOU exception responses consists of the following steps:

1. Analysis of TOU exception responses with regard to potential archiving.
2. Archiving the TOU exception responses selected in the first step.
3. Deleting the TOU exception responses from the database on the basis of the previously created archive.

4. Optional reloading of archived and deleted data.

1 Note

Note that you cannot reload individual TOU exception responses, but must always reload the entire archiving run. This

procedure should not normally be used and should be limited to severe problem cases (such as an incorrect retention
period in Customizing).

5. Optional reading of TOU exception responses from the archive and output in a list before the deletion process.
1. Analysis of Archivability of TOU Exception Responses (report REAARCH_ANALYSE_EXRESP)
Process Flow

e Selection:

First you restrict the archiving volume. To do this, enter the contract or TOU exception program for which you want the TOU
exception responses to be archived.

e Determination of final date for archiving:

The retention period in days is defined for various documents in the system in Customizing for SAP Utilities under |Tools

Archiving Define Retention Period for Archiving Objects “). The system determines the final date for archiving from
this retention period. You can only archive documents whose existence exceeds the retention period defined in
Customizing. The system uses the retention period of archiving object ISU_BILL (billing document header) to determine
the final date for archiving TOU exception responses.
